in_sanskrit.name: Ishmita
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Marriage
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ishmita एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ishmita is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ish' (god) and 'mitra' (friend). The name Ishmita signifies the goddess who is a friend of the god, symbolizing a strong and loving bond between two individuals. In Hindu mythology, Ishmita is often depicted as a goddess of marriage and fertility.
